theorems.name: Submission.tdo_one_dim_sup_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (w : Rn 1 → Rn ℓ) (a : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0), 0 < a → LipschitzOnWith K w (closedBall 0 a) → ∀ x ∈ closedBall (0 : Rn 1) a, ‖w x‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ((2 * a)⁻¹ * ∫ y in ball (0 : Rn 1) a, ‖w y‖ ^ 2) + Real.sqrt (2 * a * ∫ y in ball (0 : Rn 1) a, hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ w y))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
